# Dino Leathers

> Bovine leather wallets and belts sourced from trusted Ambur workshops. Quality-checked before dispatch. Complimentary initial debossing upon request.

## Core Identity & Brand Facts
- Brand: Dino Leathers
- Sourcing Location: Ambur, Tamil Nadu 635802, India
- Heritage: Commercial tanning in the Ambur and Palar river basin dates back to c. 1900–1905, recognized as a Town of Export Excellence (TEE) by the Government of India (DGFT 2009).
- Material Standard: Bovine leather (no synthetic fillers, PU, or bonded paper scrap)
- Sourcing Model: Online marketplace seller sourcing wallets and belts from small Ambur workshops, serving retail and wholesale buyers. Quality-checked before dispatch.
- Research & Compliance: CSIR-CLRI research anchor (established 1948) and CETPs with Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD).

## Priority Pages
- [Dino Leathers Home & Catalog](https://dinoleathers.in/): Bovine leather wallets and belts sourced from Ambur workshops.
- [Wholesale & Bulk Orders](https://dinoleathers.in/wholesale): B2B bulk orders (MOQ 50 units) with volume tier pricing.
- [The Ambur Leather Heritage](https://dinoleathers.in/ambur-heritage): Verified history of commercial tanning along the Palar River in Ambur.

## Catalog Scope (Draft Specifications)
- Wallets: Classic Bi-Fold, Slim RFID Card Sleeve, Hunter Tri-Fold, Vintage Coin Pocket, Minimalist Front Pocket, Executive Travel Organizer.
- Belts: Executive Automatic Ratchet Belt, Classic Pin Buckle Formal Belt.
